title: Newly found mysterious sites in Eastern Turkey

tellings.quote: I stumbled ac across these very mysterious sites that were brand new

plain: A researcher of ancient history called Matt says he came across very mysterious sites in eastern Turkey, in the region of Mount Ararat that was once part of Armenia, found in 2001 and 2017. He says the sites were brand new to research. To him they point to something big that happened around 12,000 BC.
